messages:
deploy-bot: Deployment started for v1.12.0 -> enabling feature new-embed-infer in gradual cohorts (5% -> 30%). Release notes: https://redwood/release/v1.12.0 :rocket:
aman (infra): seeing p95 ~120ms but p99 for model-service spiked to ~650ms in eu-west :eyes:
sre-oncall: grabbing traces now, pulling the isolate for model-inference pool-eu-west
eng-release: hold on the ramp at 30% until we confirm no tail latency regressions. do not push to 50%. can we pin the model variant for traffic?
lina (product): agree with hold — limited exposure for customers is fine. prefer gradual cohort soak vs full ramp. :thumbsup:
qa-lead: repro steps for the rerank smoke failing on 30% cohort:

```
HTTP 200 but response_time 620ms, rerank scores missing for ~2% responses
logs: /var/logs/rerank/2026-03-20-*_eu.log
```
ml-oncall: looks like model-v2-quant has a kernel fallback on certain seq lengths causing KV cache thrash. recommend pinning to model-v2-quant-stable for the cohort while we investigate
carla (solutions): we need a short mitigation so customers in beta aren't impacted. can we isolate beta-users to eu-west-stable?
eng-release: plan: 1) pause automated ramp (stopping further percent increases) 2) pin cohort beta & internal to model-v2-quant-stable 3) enable temporary kill-switch for new-embed-infer on cohort if p99 > 500ms for 5m window 4) follow-up postmortem if rollback required
sre-oncall: running the pin now: `deployctl model-pin --cohort beta --model model-v2-quant-stable --until 2026-03-21T08:00Z`
deploy-bot: model pin completed for cohort beta and internal. feature flag ramp paused at 30%. Monitoring hooks added (p99 threshold 500ms).
aman (infra): telemetry shows p99 dropping back to ~280ms after the pin. keeping an eye for 10m window. :relieved:
ml-oncall: we'll open an issue for kernel fallback and run a targeted perf test against seq lengths 1024-2048, tagging eng-runtime and eng-ml.
lina (product): thanks everyone. we'll hold public rollout until next sync. please add a short blurb to release notes that rollout is paused pending perf fix.
eng-release: noted. publishing update to release notes and ops-runbook. If things re-spike, we'll execute full rollback for v1.12.0 with `deployctl rollback v1.12.0 --to v1.11.3` — agreed?
authors (automatic): thread closed for now; reopen if metrics cross thresholds.
